questions.promptEn:

Hello, I'm Jimin. Have you ever shared things like bikes, books, or toys? Sharing saves resources and money, and it is good for the environment. Let me tell you about my experience with the sharing economy.

Last week, I used an app to get a backpack. The app allows users to easily buy and sell secondhand items. Sometimes, people also give away items that they don't need anymore. I saw a post about a nice backpack. Someone was giving it away. (A) 그것은 새것만큼 좋아 보였습니다. So, I sent a message to the person who posted it.

Jimin: Hello, can I get the backpack?
User 1: Sure.
Jimin: Great! How can I get it?
User 1: Can you come to Central Park at 3:00 p.m. tomorrow?
Jimin: Sure! I'll see you then. Thank you!

[20-22]
The next day, I got ready to go to the park. I decided to borrow a bike instead of taking a bus. My city has a bike-sharing system. Anyone who has an app can borrow a bike easily. First, you choose a bike that you want to use. Then you scan the QR code on the bike. This makes the bike's lock open.

Before I rode to the park, I checked the bike carefully. Sometimes, the bikes are not in good condition. This time, everything looked fine, so I headed for the park. When I got there, I returned the bike to a station in the park. Using the bike was really easy. Also, I was happy to help the environment.
